```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(arrow)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
library(ggspatial)
library(kableExtra)

source(here("R", "od_io.R"))
source(here("R", "map_theme.R"))
```

```{r}
build_od_parquet()
od <- open_od()
```

```{r}
selected_months <- c(
          202206, 202209, 202212,
  202303, 202306, 202309, 202312,
  202403, 202406, 202409, 202412,
  202503, 202506, 202509, 202512,
  202603, 202606, 202609
  )

total_bus <- od %>%
  filter(
    MODE == "bus",
    YYYYMM %in% selected_months,
    DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY",
    TIME_PER_HOUR %in% 6:9
    ) %>%
  collect()

period_name <- "Non-control"
```

```{r}
subzone <- read_sf(
  here("data", "raw", "MasterPlan2019SubzoneBoundaryNoSeaGEOJSON.geojson")
  ) %>%
  st_transform(3414)

busStops <- read_sf(
  here("data", "raw", "LTABusStop.geojson")
  ) %>%
  st_transform(3414)

hub_zones <- list(
  CBD = c(
    "PHILLIP", "RAFFLES PLACE", "BAYFRONT SUBZONE",
    "NICOLL", "ANSON", "TANJONG PAGAR", "MAXWELL",
    "CECIL", "CENTRAL SUBZONE", "BUGIS",
    "MARINA CENTRE", "CITY HALL"
    ),

  `Jurong East` = c(
    "JURONG GATEWAY", "INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS PARK",
    "LAKESIDE (LEISURE)", "LAKESIDE (BUSINESS)"
    ),

  Woodlands = c(
    "NORTH COAST", "WOODLANDS REGIONAL CENTRE"
    ),

  Tampines = c(
    "TAMPINES NORTH", "TAMPINES WEST", "TAMPINES EAST"
    )
  )

hub_subzones <- bind_rows(
  subzone %>%
    filter(SUBZONE_N %in% hub_zones$CBD) %>%
    mutate(zone = "CBD"),

  subzone %>%
    filter(SUBZONE_N %in% hub_zones$`Jurong East`) %>%
    mutate(zone = "Jurong East"),

  subzone %>%
    filter(SUBZONE_N %in% hub_zones$Woodlands) %>%
    mutate(zone = "Woodlands"),

  subzone %>%
    filter(SUBZONE_N %in% hub_zones$Tampines) %>%
    mutate(zone = "Tampines")
  )

dict_hub_stop <- st_join(
  busStops,
  hub_subzones %>% select(zone),
  join = st_intersects,
  left = FALSE
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(BUS_STOP_NUM, zone) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
island_total <- total_bus %>%
  group_by(YEAR_MONTH) %>%
  summarise(
    total_island_trips = sum(TOTAL_TRIPS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
    )

arrivals <- total_bus %>%
  inner_join(
    dict_hub_stop,
    by = c("DESTINATION_PT_CODE" = "BUS_STOP_NUM")
  ) %>%
  group_by(YEAR_MONTH, zone) %>%
  summarise(
    total_arrivals = sum(TOTAL_TRIPS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

departures <- total_bus %>%
  inner_join(
    dict_hub_stop,
    by = c("ORIGIN_PT_CODE" = "BUS_STOP_NUM")
  ) %>%
  group_by(YEAR_MONTH, zone) %>%
  summarise(
    total_departures = sum(TOTAL_TRIPS, na.rm = TRUE),
    trips_to_cbd = sum(
      TOTAL_TRIPS[
        DESTINATION_PT_CODE %in% 
          dict_hub_stop$BUS_STOP_NUM[
            dict_hub_stop$zone == "CBD"
            ]
        ],
      na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

hub_metrics <- arrivals %>%
  left_join(
    departures,
    by = c("YEAR_MONTH", "zone")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    island_total,
    by = "YEAR_MONTH"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    attraction_share = total_arrivals / total_island_trips,
    in_out_ratio = total_arrivals / total_departures,
    cbd_outflow_rate = trips_to_cbd / total_departures
  ) %>%
  arrange(YEAR_MONTH, zone)
```

```{r}
stop_geom <- busStops %>%
  distinct(BUS_STOP_NUM, .keep_all = TRUE)

trip_distance_summary <- total_bus %>%
  inner_join(
    dict_hub_stop,
    by = c("DESTINATION_PT_CODE" = "BUS_STOP_NUM")
    ) %>%
  mutate(
    origin_idx = match(
      ORIGIN_PT_CODE,
      stop_geom$BUS_STOP_NUM
      ),
    dest_idx = match(
      DESTINATION_PT_CODE,
      stop_geom$BUS_STOP_NUM
      )
    ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(origin_idx), !is.na(dest_idx)) %>%
  mutate(
    distance_km = as.numeric(
      st_distance(
        st_geometry(stop_geom)[origin_idx],
        st_geometry(stop_geom)[dest_idx],
        by_element = TRUE
      )
    ) / 1000
  ) %>%
  group_by(YEAR_MONTH, zone) %>%
  summarise(
    weighted_avg_dist_km = weighted.mean(
      distance_km,
      TOTAL_TRIPS,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
final_metrics <- hub_metrics %>%
  left_join(
    trip_distance_summary,
    by = c("YEAR_MONTH", "zone")
  ) %>%
  select(
    YEAR_MONTH,
    zone,
    total_arrivals,
    total_departures,
    attraction_share,
    in_out_ratio,
    cbd_outflow_rate,
    weighted_avg_dist_km
  )

write_csv(
  final_metrics,
  here("data", "processed", "hub_bus_metrics_afterSD.csv")
)
```

```{r}
dict_stop_subzone <- st_join(
  busStops %>% 
    select(BUS_STOP_NUM), 
  subzone %>% select(SUBZONE_N), 
  join = st_intersects, 
  left = FALSE
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    BUS_STOP_NUM,
    origin_subzone = SUBZONE_N
  ) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
od_subzone_hub <- total_bus %>% 
  inner_join(
    dict_stop_subzone,
    by = c("ORIGIN_PT_CODE" = "BUS_STOP_NUM")
    ) %>% 
  inner_join(
    dict_hub_stop,
    by = c("DESTINATION_PT_CODE" = "BUS_STOP_NUM")
    ) %>%
  group_by(zone, origin_subzone) %>% 
  summarise(
    total_trips = sum(TOTAL_TRIPS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    avg_monthly_trips =
      total_trips / n_distinct(total_bus$YEAR_MONTH)
    )
```

```{r}
service_sheds <- od_subzone_hub %>%
  group_by(zone) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(avg_monthly_trips),
    origin_subzone,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hub_total = sum(avg_monthly_trips),
    trip_share = avg_monthly_trips / hub_total,
    cumulative_share = cumsum(trip_share),
    cumulative_before = lag(
      cumulative_share,
      default = 0
    ),
    shed_type = case_when(
      cumulative_before < 0.25 ~ "Core",
      cumulative_before < 0.50 ~ "Strong",
      cumulative_before < 0.75 ~ "Weak",
      TRUE ~ "Peripheral"
    ),
    principal = shed_type %in% c("Core", "Strong")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    period = period_name
  )

shed_summary <- service_sheds %>%
  group_by(period, zone, shed_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_subzones = n(),
    total_trips = sum(avg_monthly_trips),
    flow_share = sum(trip_share),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

shed_summary <- shed_summary %>%
  mutate(
    shed_type = factor(
      shed_type,
      levels = c(
        "Core",
        "Strong",
        "Weak",
        "Peripheral"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(zone, shed_type)
```

```{r}
shed_levels <- c(
  "Core",
  "Strong",
  "Weak",
  "Peripheral",
  "No flow"
)

centre_order <- c(
  "Woodlands",
  "Tampines",
  "Jurong Lake District",
  "CBD"
)
```

```{r}
principal_sheds <- service_sheds %>%
  filter(principal) %>%
  distinct(
    period,
    zone,
    origin_subzone
  )

shed_sizes <- principal_sheds %>%
  count(
    period,
    zone,
    name = "n_principal"
  )

shed_intersections <- principal_sheds %>%
  rename(center_i = zone) %>%
  inner_join(
    principal_sheds %>% rename(center_j = zone),
    by = c("period", "origin_subzone"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  count(period, center_i, center_j, name = "n_overlap")

shed_overlap <- crossing(
  period = period_name,
  center_i = names(hub_zones),
  center_j = names(hub_zones)
) %>%
  left_join(
    shed_intersections,
    by = c("period", "center_i", "center_j")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    shed_sizes %>%
      rename(center_j = zone, n_j = n_principal),
    by = c("period", "center_j")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_overlap = replace_na(n_overlap, 0L),
    overlap_pct = 100 * n_overlap / n_j
  )
```

```{r}
subzone_membership <- principal_sheds %>%
  count(
    period,
    origin_subzone,
    name = "n_centers"
  )

unique_sheds <- principal_sheds %>%
  left_join(
    subzone_membership,
    by = c("period", "origin_subzone")
  ) %>%
  filter(n_centers == 1) %>%
  count(period, zone, name = "n_unique")

self_containment <- shed_sizes %>%
  left_join(
    unique_sheds,
    by = c("period", "zone")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_unique = replace_na(n_unique, 0L),
    unique_pct = 100 * n_unique / n_principal
  )

shed_overlap_final <- shed_overlap %>%
  left_join(
    self_containment %>%
      select(period, zone, unique_pct) %>%
      rename(center_j = zone),
    by = c("period", "center_j")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    overlap_pct = if_else(
      center_i == center_j,
      unique_pct,
      overlap_pct
    )
  )
```

```{r}
overlap_plot_data <- shed_overlap_final %>%
  mutate(
    center_i = recode(
      center_i,
      "Jurong East" = "Jurong Lake District"
    ),
    center_j = recode(
      center_j,
      "Jurong East" = "Jurong Lake District"
    ),
    overlap = overlap_pct / 100
  )
```

```{r}
p_overlap <- stylized_matrix(
  center_j,
  center_i,
  overlap,
  data = overlap_plot_data,
  order = centre_order,
  limits = c(0, 1),
  legend_title = "Overlap",
  title = "Bus Principal Service Shed Overlap",
  subtitle = "Bus | AM Peak | Non-control Period",
  caption = paste(
    "Read by column. Diagonal indicates the share of",
    "exclusive principal subzones."
  )
)

p_overlap
```

```{r}
shed_map_data <- crossing(
  zone = names(hub_zones),
  origin_subzone = unique(subzone$SUBZONE_N)
) %>%
  left_join(
    service_sheds %>%
      select(
        zone,
        origin_subzone,
        shed_type,
        trip_share,
        cumulative_share
      ),
    by = c("zone", "origin_subzone")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    shed_type = replace_na(shed_type, "No flow"),
    zone = recode(
      zone,
      "Jurong East" = "Jurong Lake District"
    ),
    shed_type = factor(
      shed_type,
      levels = shed_levels
    )
  )
```

```{r}
service_sheds_sf <- subzone %>%
  rename(origin_subzone = SUBZONE_N) %>%
  left_join(
    shed_map_data,
    by = "origin_subzone"
  )
```

```{r}
hub_subzones <- hub_subzones %>%
  mutate(
    zone = recode(
      zone,
      "Jurong East" = "Jurong Lake District"
    )
  )

plots <- lapply(seq_along(centre_order), function(i) {

  current_centre <- centre_order[i]

  map_data <- service_sheds_sf %>%
    filter(zone == current_centre)

  centre_outline <- hub_subzones %>%
    filter(zone == current_centre)

  centre_outline <- st_sf(
    geometry = st_union(centre_outline)
  )

  sg_map(
    data = map_data,
    var = shed_type,
    type = "discrete",
    values = shed_colours,
    breaks = shed_breaks,
    labels = shed_labels,
    outline = centre_outline,
    rings_km = c(5, 10, 15),
    legend = "right",
    legend_title = "Service Shed",
    title = paste0(
      "(", letters[i], ") ",
      current_centre
    ),
    bb = st_bbox(subzone)
  )
})
```

```{r}
p_service_sheds <- wrap_plots(
  plots,
  ncol = 2,
  guides = "collect"
) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Bus service sheds (AM peak, Non-control period)",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Origin subzones ranked by their share of",
      "bus trips entering the centre (cumulative %)."
    ),
    caption = paste(
      "Data: LTA DataMall passenger volume by OD (Bus), monthly average of 18 months; URA Master Plan 2019 subzones."
    )
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0
    )
  )

p_service_sheds
```

```{r}
final_metrics_non <- final_metrics

service_sheds_non <- service_sheds
shed_summary_non <- shed_summary
shed_overlap_non <- shed_overlap_final

service_sheds_sf_non <- service_sheds_sf
p_overlap_non <- p_overlap
p_service_sheds_non <- p_service_sheds
```

```{r}
        shed_type,
        trip_share,
        cumulative_share
      ),
    by = c("zone", "origin_subzone")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    shed_type = replace_na(shed_type, "No flow"),
    zone = recode(
      zone,
      "Jurong East" = "Jurong Lake District"
    ),
    shed_type = factor(
      shed_type,
      levels = shed_levels
    )
  )
```

```{r}
service_sheds_sf <- subzone %>%
  rename(origin_subzone = SUBZONE_N) %>%
  left_join(
    shed_map_data,
    by = "origin_subzone"
  )
```

```{r}
plots <- lapply(seq_along(centre_order), function(i) {

  current_centre <- centre_order[i]

  map_data <- service_sheds_sf %>%
    filter(zone == current_centre)

  centre_outline <- hub_subzones %>%
    filter(zone == current_centre)

  centre_outline <- st_sf(
    geometry = st_union(centre_outline)
  )

  sg_map(
    data = map_data,
    var = shed_type,
    type = "discrete",
    values = shed_colours,
    breaks = shed_breaks,
    labels = shed_labels,
    outline = centre_outline,
    rings_km = c(5, 10, 15),
    legend = "right",
    legend_title = "Service Shed",
    title = paste0(
      "(", letters[i], ") ",
      current_centre
    ),
    bb = st_bbox(subzone)
  )
})
```

```{r}
p_service_sheds <- wrap_plots(
  plots,
  ncol = 2,
  guides = "collect"
) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Bus service sheds (AM peak, SD Control period)",
    subtitle = paste(

      "bus trips entering the centre (cumulative %)."
    ),
    caption = paste(
      "Data: LTA DataMall passenger volume by OD (Bus), monthly average of 9 months; URA Master Plan 2019 subzones."
    )
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0
    )
  )

p_service_sheds
```

```{r}
make_overlap_panel <- function(df, period_label) {

  plot_data <- df %>%
    mutate(
      center_i = recode(
        center_i,
        "Jurong East" = "Jurong Lake District"
      ),
      center_j = recode(
        center_j,
        "Jurong East" = "Jurong Lake District"
      ),
      overlap = overlap_pct / 100
    )

  stylized_matrix(
    center_j,
    center_i,
    overlap,
    data = plot_data,
    order = centre_order,
    limits = c(0, 1),
    legend_title = "Overlap",
    title = period_label,
    caption = NULL,
    tag = NULL
  ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 13,
        face = "plain",
        hjust = 0.5
      )
    )
}

p_sd_panel <- make_overlap_panel(
  shed_overlap_sd,
  "SD control"
)

p_non_panel <- make_overlap_panel(
  shed_overlap_non,
  "Non-control"
)
```

```{r}
p_overlap_compare <- (
  p_sd_panel | p_non_panel
) +
  plot_layout(
    guides = "collect",
    widths = c(1, 1)
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Bus principal service-shed overlap (AM peak)",
    subtitle = "SD control vs Non-control",
    tag_levels = "a",
    tag_prefix = "(",
    tag_suffix = ")",

    caption = paste0(
      "Read by column: share of the column centre's principal shed ",
      "also belonging to the row centre. Diagonal = exclusive principal-shed share.\n",
      "Data: LTA DataMall Bus OD, 9 months (SD control) and 18 months (Non-control); ",
      "URA Master Plan 2019 subzones."
    ),

    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")
  )

p_overlap_compare
```

```{r}
metrics_table <- bind_rows(
  final_metrics_sd %>%
    mutate(Period = "SD Control"),

  final_metrics_non %>%
    mutate(Period = "Non-control")
) %>%
  group_by(zone, Period) %>%
  summarise(
    `Attraction (%)` = mean(attraction_share, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    `In/Out Ratio` = mean(in_out_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    `CBD Outflow (%)` = mean(cbd_outflow_rate, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    `Average Distance (km)` = mean(weighted_avg_dist_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    zone = recode(
      zone,
      "Jurong East" = "Jurong Lake District"
    ),
    zone = factor(zone, levels = centre_order),
    Period = factor(
      Period,
      levels = c("SD Control", "Non-control")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(zone, Period)
```
